services.name: Private Events & Catering
services.desc: From their 1st to their 50th, we are easily accessible for relatives of all ages, and have no problem providing kid-friendly catering. As most kid-centered events fall on Saturday and Sunday mornings and early afternoons, be sure to ask about our delicious brunch package; featuring bloody marys, mimosas, and an optional custom omelette station. Reconnect and reminisce in style at Mulcahy’s, the ultimate venue for unforgettable reunions on Long Island. Whether you’re gathering with former classmates, family members, or old friends, our team will help you plan every detail for an event that’s relaxed, memorable, and easy to enjoy. services.name: The Ballroom
services.desc: The Ridgewood Ballroom refers to the traditional concert hall area of Mulcahy’s with the dividing wall closed. For larger concerts and holiday nights, the wall may be open to incorporate the JD Room into this space (either as additional seating or standing room) making it a ‘full venue’ event. Our most famous room houses the main stage and three island bars, state of the art sound system, multiple screens and jumbo video wall. Perfect for larger events up to 1000 people, the space hosts various annual fundraisers, expos, corporate meetings and conferences, awards ceremonies, and even some sporting events - boxing rings and MMA cages are often featured.
